title: Projection and evaluation transport for the tensor counit transpose
statement: For scalar functors S,T between four categories, compact-support functors P,P′ with b:PT≅SP′, the target tensor functors at a chosen K, source and target projection isomorphisms, evaluation arrows and right-unit maps, assume the projection square at the chosen objects, naturality of the target projection at the dualizing-object comparison, tensor naturality at the evaluation arrow, the evaluation square and scalar right unitality. Then scalar transport of the source inverse-projection/evaluation/right-unit composite equals the target composite after the specified tensor-domain arrow. The intermediate projection need not be invertible.

source.place: Compatibility (3), Coefficient transport of the tensor counit transpose

proof.text: Precompose both sides by T(π.hom) followed by b and cancel this isomorphism at the end. Expand the domain arrow. The projection square followed by projection naturality cancels the target projection with its recorded inverse field. The evaluation square, tensor naturality and scalar right-unit equation identify both paths. Projection isomorphisms are passed as data so the chosen inverse is shared by both sides.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility (3), tensor and mixed Cartesian squares.

theorem orderedTensor_coefficient_arrow_square
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} {C' : Type u₃} {D' : Type u₄}
    [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D] [Category.{v₃} C'] [Category.{v₄} D']
    (P : C ⥤ D) (P' : C' ⥤ D') (S : C ⥤ C') (T : D ⥤ D')
    (RY : D ⥤ D) (RY' : D' ⥤ D')
    (b : P ⋙ T ≅ S ⋙ P')
    (W L : C) (W' L' E : C') (I K : D) (I' : D')
    (ρ : RY.obj I ⟶ K) (ρ' : RY'.obj I' ⟶ T.obj K)
    (π : RY.obj (P.obj W) ≅ P.obj L)
    (πs : RY'.obj (P'.obj (S.obj W)) ⟶ P'.obj E)
    (π' : RY'.obj (P'.obj W') ≅ P'.obj L')
    (ε : P.obj W ⟶ I) (ε' : P'.obj W' ⟶ I') (cw : S.obj W ⟶ W')
    (d : S.obj L ⟶ E) (v : E ⟶ L')
    (δW : T.obj (RY.obj (P.obj W)) ⟶ RY'.obj (T.obj (P.obj W)))
    (δI : T.obj (RY.obj I) ⟶ RY'.obj (T.obj I)) (e : T.obj I ⟶ I')
    (hπ : RY'.map (P'.map cw) ≫ π'.hom = πs ≫ P'.map v)
    (hδ : T.map (RY.map ε) ≫ δI = δW ≫ RY'.map (T.map ε))
    (hproj : T.map π.hom ≫ b.hom.app L ≫ P'.map d =
      δW ≫ RY'.map (b.hom.app W) ≫ πs)
    (he : δI ≫ RY'.map e ≫ ρ' = T.map ρ)
    (hunit : b.hom.app W ≫ P'.map cw ≫ ε' = T.map ε ≫ e)
    (domain : S.obj L ⟶ L')
    (hdomain : domain = d ≫ v) :
    b.inv.app L ≫ T.map (π.inv ≫ RY.map ε ≫ ρ) =
      P'.map domain ≫ π'.inv ≫ RY'.map ε' ≫ ρ'
